summary: Code runs and is syntactically valid with reasonable simulation logic, but it does not fully implement the required metrics and some specified functionality (e.g., policy compliance rate, masks purchased, time-to-70% adoption, incidence rate). Main is correctly called at global scope.

issues.description: Missing required metrics: time_to_70_percent_adoption, policy_compliance_rate, average_compliance_duration, masks_purchased, enforcement_actions_count (distinct from fines), and incidence_rate.
issues.solution: Compute and include: (1) time_to_70_percent_adoption via first day adoption_rate >= 0.7; (2) policy_compliance_rate as fraction of agents complying during mandate days (e.g., masked among those present in mandate-sensitive locations); (3) average_compliance_duration by tracking consecutive adoption streaks per agent; (4) masks_purchased by incrementing a counter whenever a sale occurs in purchase_step or Retailer.sell; (5) enforcement_actions_count by counting both fines and entry refusals (add entry_refusal logic); (6) incidence_rate by exposing new_infections_over_time in metrics.

issues.description: No explicit tracking of masks purchased; retailer sales are not aggregated into a metric.
issues.solution: Introduce a simulation-level counter (e.g., self.total_masks_purchased) and increment it by the number sold from Retailer.sell(). Include this in compute_metrics under 'masks_purchased'.

issues.description: Policy compliance rate is not computed; enforcement only counts fines without a compliance metric.
issues.solution: During mandate days, track visits and compute compliance as the share of visitors who are masked in mandate-sensitive locations. Aggregate daily and summarize in compute_metrics.

issues.description: Time-to-70% adoption metric required by spec is not provided; instead, time_to_50_percent_adoption is computed.
issues.solution: Add time_to_70_percent_adoption as the first day where adoption_rate_over_time >= 0.7 (retain 50% if desired as an extra).

issues.description: Incidence rate is not included in the metrics payload even when disease module is active.
issues.solution: Include 'incidence_rate' as the daily new infections series (self.new_infections_over_time) or a per-100k normalized version in metrics.

issues.description: Enforcement actions are only fines; entry refusal behavior is not modeled though specified.
issues.solution: Add an 'entry_refusal' outcome when mandate_active and noncompliance occurs with some probability; track 'enforcement_actions_count' including both fines and refusals.

issues.description: Entity attributes and parameters do not fully align with the provided specification (e.g., Person lacks several fields like health_state, vaccination_status; Location lacks capacity, transmission_modifier; parameters not configurable via inputs).
issues.solution: Extend classes to include specified attributes or map existing fields clearly; allow configuration of parameters (e.g., contact rates, transmission modifiers) through constructor or CLI to better match the spec.
